error[L0100]: a recovery that runs statements names the error after `else`: write `else (problem)`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/statements-after-a-bare-else-name-its-binder/program.ldn:9:16
  |
9 |     attempt(n) else
  |                ^^^^
  = note: [1030]: `else value` stands in for the call's result; `else (problem)` opens a block that closes with `end`, and `_ = problem` discards an error the block does not use
  = help: write `(problem)` after `else`
